Conhecimento técnico profundo em sistemas e componentes relevantes para a indústria em que a empresa atua.

title: Chefe do tráfico na Baixada Campista é preso em Campos
description:
Chefe do tráfico na Baixada Campista é preso em Campos

Polícia Civil prende chefe do tráfico da Baixada Campista e mais quatro suspeitos no Centro de Campos dos Goytacazes.

Um homem apontado como chefe do tráfico na Baixada Campista foi preso nesta quarta-feira (23) por policiais civis da 134ª DP (Campos dos Goytacazes), com apoio da Polícia Militar. A prisão ocorreu no Centro de Campos, no Norte Fluminense.

Além do principal alvo da operação, outros quatro homens foram presos em flagrante. Eles foram autuados por associação ao tráfico de drogas e porte ilegal de arma de fogo com numeração suprimida.

A ação decorre de investigações sobre o tráfico de drogas em Poço Gordo, localidade da Baixada Campista. De acordo com a polícia, o chefe do tráfico também extorquia comerciantes da região com ameaças constantes.

A 134ª DP representou à Justiça pela prisão temporária do líder e pela expedição de mandados de busca e apreensão nos endereços da quadrilha. A Justiça autorizou as diligências, cumpridas na manhã de quarta-feira.

O suspeito foi capturado no Centro de Campos e não resistiu à prisão. Em uma das casas, policiais encontraram cadernos de anotações sobre tráfico e extorsão, arma de fogo com numeração raspada, munições e rádios comunicadores.

Quatro homens que estavam na residência foram levados para a delegacia. Um deles, segundo os agentes, é o gerente do tráfico e atuava como braço direito do chefe. As investigações prosseguem para identificar outros envolvidos.

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. Esta oportunidade oferece um ambiente de trabalho desafiador e colaborativo, com possibilidades de crescimento profissional dentro do Grupo Alvorada.

Job Description Summary

The General Manager, Power Conversion & Storage LATAM is responsible for full regional P&L (160m$ sales, +200M$ internal and external orders, 700 employees), commercial and execution performance in the region including team leadership, business development, orders, sales, engineering, project execution, production, after sales services & customer relations.

You are responsible to

description:
Sobre nós

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independentes do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. busca constantemente os melhores talentos com ambição de fazer o impossível.

P Future 2025 | Transição de Carreira - Londrina e Região

Sobre a oportunidade

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP Future , uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos.

Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais com experiência comercial em outros segmentos que desejam migrar para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc., você terá suporte para rápida integração, desenvolvimento de habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento em produtos de investimentos e imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. O programa oferece uma trajetória de carreira robusta, incluindo a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor de investimentos de referência.

Se você possui experiência comercial e quer fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, confira os pré-requisitos abaixo!

Saiba mais sobre nosso dia a dia no Instagram e no LinkedIn .

Confira nossas avaliações no Glassdoor .

O que Procuramos

Pré-requisitos essenciais:

  • Ter alinhamento com nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse em transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • Atuação em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamento, fintechs, bebidas, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • Certificação CPA-20 ou CEA (caso não possua, oferecemos curso gratuito em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro).

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuar na Assessoria de Investimentos, aconselhando e auxiliando na gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaborar portfólios de investimentos alinhados ao perfil e objetivos dos clientes;
  • Analisar alocações externas, elaborar estudos comparativos e identificar oportunidades;
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado e atualidades econômicas;
  • Manter contato frequente com clientes, de forma online e presencial.

*Obs.: A contratação é via CLT.

Esta vaga é destinada a um pool de talentos em todo o Brasil, podendo haver um tempo maior de retorno. Também há oportunidades nos processos presenciais dos XDays XP Future disponíveis aqui: Oportunidades XP Inc. ou

Etapas do Processo

  1. Triagem inicial: Análise do currículo para verificar compatibilidade com a vaga.
  2. Testes gerais: Avaliação cultural com teste Mindsight e raciocínio lógico com a Predictive Index.
  3. Entrevista com Recrutamento: Discussão sobre expectativas e objetivos profissionais.
  4. Entrevista com liderança: Discussão sobre sua visão e contribuição para a equipe.
  5. Entrevista com Head Comercial: Avaliação do perfil e competências para a operação.
  6. Entrevista cultural: Verificação do alinhamento com os valores da empresa.
  7. Oferta: Apresentação da proposta, remuneração e benefícios.

Veja o vídeo sobre o Fator XP e conheça mais sobre nossa cultura e propósito.

Benefícios

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive dependentes);
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Zenklub;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • New Value (clube de benefícios);
  • Licença parental de 6 meses maternidade e 20 dias paternidade;
  • Auxílio Creche.

Vida Financeira:

  • Fundos de Investimentos Exclusivos;
  • Assessoria de Investimentos;
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade;
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, imobiliário, etc.).

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

Nossa rotina de trabalho varia conforme a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial ou mais flexível. Valorizamos a interação pessoal e o uso do escritório para fortalecer nossas relações, sempre com foco na cultura empreendedora e na autonomia.

Gestão diária de indicadores de produtividade, qualidade e custos. Analisar dados com profundidade e orientar a operação com base em números;

Desenhar e reportar capacidade de armazenagem dos CD's, assim como capacidade mensal de pedidos - garantindo ou o aumento da capacidade quando necessário ou, eventualmente, mudança de CD;
Garantir padrões de qualidade e de acordo com exigências regulatórias e sanitárias;
Trabalhar próximo ao time de tecnologia para garantir que estamos sempre em busca de inovação;
Tomar decisões rápidas baseadas em dados;
Construir e acompanhar indicadores operacionais e estratégicos;

Experiência liderando grandes times, com foco em pessoas, produtividade e hands on. Aqui não é só atrás da telinha, não. Tem muita gestão pelo exemplo.
Conhecimento de leis trabalhistas e sindicais;
Capacidade de estruturar planejamento financeiro e planos de ação - visão analítica e de resolução de problemas;
Vivência com P&L e forte domínio sobre gestão financeira de operações;
Perfil analítico com excelente visão de dados, construção e acompanhamento de indicadores operacionais;
Mentalidade aberta a novas ideias, com humildade intelectual - não buscamos quem acha que já sabe tudo;
Multiplicador cultural - você precisa se incomodar e querer gerar mudança, disposto a ousar. Autonomia tem um preço aqui na Cubbo e é o de ser referência!
Inglês ou espanhol fluente - aqui não é só para adicionar complexidade na contratação, pois você terá reuniões frequentes com times globais que irão ocorrer em um destes idiomas;

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão.

Nosso compromisso é promover uma cultura de inclusão da diversidade, que capacita nossos colaboradores a contribuir com o seu melhor. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas, sem distinção de etnia, religião, orientação sexual, identidade e/ou expressão de gênero, idade, raça, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

A SPDM é uma empregadora de igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todas as pessoas que assim atendam os requisitos mínimos.

Valorizamos o compartilhamento de ideias, o desenvolvimento de uma cultura de trabalho em equipe, respeito a diversidade e inclusão.

MISSÃO

Atuar com excelência na atenção à saúde sem preconceito, distinção ou classificação dos cidadãos.

VISÃO

Ser reconhecida como organização filantrópica brasileira em saúde de maior abrangência e competência.

- Capacitação

-Confiabilidade

-Equidade

-Humanização

-Qualidade

-Sustentabilidade ecológica, econômica e social

-Tradição

Inaugurado em 1991, o Hospital das Clínicas Luzia de Pinho Melo destaca-se pelo atendimento de média e alta complexidade.

Referência em neurocirurgia, cirurgia vascular, ortopedia e oncologia, o Hospital realiza atendimento gratuito – 100% SUS .

Em 23 de fevereiro de 1991, o Ambulatório de Especialidades e Pronto-Socorro de Mogi das Cruzes passou a se chamar Hospital das Clínicas Luzia de Pinho Melo em 27 de agosto de 1991, uma homenagem à mãe do ex-prefeito Padre Melo. O Hospital das Clínicas Luzia de Pinho Melo é gerenciado pela Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina (SPDM), desde 2004, que possui contrato de gestão com a Secretaria de Estado da Saúde.

Desde o início da gestão SPDM , o Hospital das Clínicas Luzia de Pinho Melo busca a excelência do serviço público de saúde. Ações de responsabilidade social e compromisso com os princípios do Sistema Único de Saúde sempre embasaram suas diretrizes.

Faça parte do nosso time!

Gostaríamos de esclarecer que nossa empresa não cobra quaisquer taxas ou valores para participar de processos seletivos. Acreditamos que a busca por uma oportunidade deve ser acessível a todos, e nossa prioridade é encontrar os melhores talentos sem imposições financeiras.

Se você receber qualquer solicitação de pagamento em nome da nossa empresa, pedimos que denuncie imediatamente, através do nosso canal confidencial . Estamos comprometidos com a transparência e a ética em todos os nossos processos.

Todos os processos seletivos da instituição são publicados em canais oficiais de divulgação e realizados através da plataforma digital de recrutamento e seleção, e a comunicação com as pessoas candidatas é realizada por profissionais com o uso de e-mail institucional.

Confira as vagas disponíveis! Nosso processo seletivo tem etapas eliminatórias e classificatórias. ATENÇÃO: Temos vagas temporárias e efetivas. Se você quer fazer parte do nosso time, cadastre seu currículo.

Agradecemos seu interesse em fazer parte da nossa equipe e desejamos boa sorte em nosso processo seletivo!

A SPDM recebeu o Certificado de Clima Organizacional, concedido pela FIA – Fundação Instituto de Administração. O selo é resultado da Pesquisa de Clima Organizacional FEEX - Employee Experience, aplicada aos nossos colaboradores que reconhecem os esforços da equipe diretiva, líderes, equipe de gestão de pessoas e todos os profissionais na construção de um ambiente organizacional agradável e que contribui para trabalho mais harmonioso, construção de equipes unidas e uma organização mais produtiva.

Comitê de Diversidade

Na SPDM temos o Comitê de Diversidade, esse tem o objetivo de debater e promover na instituição ações de inclusão e diversidade, buscando a pluralidade no ambiente de trabalho. Times diversos criam ambientes de trabalho acolhedores, com menos julgamentos e mais abertura para que todos manifestem seus pontos de vista.

Selo Municipal de Direitos Humanos e Diversidade

Não temos como falar de pessoas sem falar em Diversidade e Inclusão, acreditamos na equidade e buscamos gente que queira somar com a gente. Nossa filial recebeu o Selo Municipal de Direitos Humanos e Diversidade – 6ª Edição, oferecido pela Secretaria Municipal de Direitos Humanos e Cidadania, da Prefeitura do Munícipio de São Paulo.O Selo é o reconhecimento pelos esforços em construir uma agenda positiva de Direitos Humanos e Diversidade com os diversos públicos de interesse, como nossos usuários, fornecedores, colaboradores, sociedade, entre outros.

Selo Empresa Amiga do Migrante – Edição 2024

Em novembro de 2023, a SPDM Hospital São Paulo e Instituições Afiliadas aderiu ao termo de parceria com a ONG Visão Mundial com o projeto “Ven, Tú Puedes!”. Essa parceria tem como objetivo promover a inclusão de migrantes e refugiados, oportunizando o acesso dessas pessoas aos processos seletivos da empresa, podendo fazer parte da nossa força de trabalho. Como fruto desse trabalho, a SPDM HSP e Instituições Afiliadas recebeu o “Selo Empresa Amiga do Migrante” na Categoria Destaque, uma iniciativa da ONG Visão Mundial Brasil, por meio do projeto “Ven, tú Puedes!”, concedido por termos assinado o termo de parceria, realizado ações de sensibilização sobre a contratação de pessoas migrantes e refugiadas, por contratarmos pessoas encaminhadas pelo projeto e possuirmos um programa robusto em Diversidade e Inclusão.

Job description

Quem somos:

Aqui na HeartmanHouse buscamos transformar o Brasil por meio da gestão, impactando organizações e pessoas com nossa objetividade e sensibilidade. Main responsibilities

Desejável: conhecimentos em análise de dados e construção de modelos de incentivos para estratégias de remuneração variável.

description:

A Ultra nasceu acreditando que o esporte e a atividade física são capazes de transformar nós mesmos, o outro e também a sociedade.

Existimos para ser uma ferramenta poderosa de transformação através de atividades físicas e esportes. Nascemos como um agente incansável de mudanças, incentivando, motivando e oferecendo a estrutura e serviços adequados para a prática de exercícios.

Ensino superior em Educação Física, desejável graduação adicional em Administração, Gestão de Negócios ou Pessoas.

Descrição da Vaga

A EssenceMediacom busca uma Pessoa Diretora de Mídia para liderar a conta global de um de nossos principais clientes. Esta é uma oportunidade única para profissionais que desejam atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, inovador e de alcance internacional, construindo uma presença global consistente e impactante para uma das marcas mais relevantes e admiradas do mundo. Se você tem experiência em contas globais, vivência trabalhando em inglês, perfil estratégico e paixão por construir marcas que fazem a diferença, queremos conhecer você!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  1. Planejamento Estratégico de Mídia: Desenvolver projetos de mídia abrangentes que estejam alinhados com os objetivos de marketing do cliente, garantindo o uso otimizado de canais online e offline.
  2. Análise de Tendências: Manter-se à frente das tendências do setor e dos novos canais de mídia, oferecendo soluções inovadoras e recomendações para o cliente.
  3. Relações com Mercado: Manter e fortalecer relações sólidas com veículos, fornecedores e outros parceiros, negociando condições favoráveis e garantindo espaços de destaque.
  4. Gestão de Projetos: Acompanhar a execução e os resultados ao longo do projeto, para redirecionar o que for preciso para o sucesso do projeto.
  5. Comunicação com o Cliente: Liderar os projetos junto ao cliente, fornecendo atualizações regulares, insights e conselhos estratégicos.

Porta la tua grande professionalità in Carrefour e partecipa alla realizzazione della nostra Visione imprenditoriale: essere leader nella transizione alimentare per tutti .
Non perdere l'occasione di entrare a far parte di una Multinazionale-Digitale, leader nel franchising, attenta allo sviluppo professionale e al work-life balance delle persone che ci lavorano.
COSA CI ASPETTIAMO DA TE?
Sei perfetto/a per questo lavoro se hai:

  • esperienza come Capo/a Reparto Gastronomia (Salumi e Formaggi) o Vice di almeno 5 anni
  • capacità di gestire persone (turni, formazione, motivazione, richiami)
  • capacità di leggere il conto economico del reparto e monitorare i KPI
  • familiarità con sistemi informativi per l'inserimento di ordini merce
In più per il reparto Gastronomia, ci aspettiamo che tu:
  • conosca in modo approfondito il prodotto
  • sappia utilizzare le strumentazioni tecniche (bilancia, coltelli, forni, ...)
  • sia predisposto/a ad assistere e consigliare la clientela
  • sia sempre motivato/a al raggiungimento degli obiettivi
COSA FARAI?
La risorsa assumerà un ruolo manageriale per il quale si richiedono spiccate doti tecniche nel reparto di appartenenza. In particolare il/la Capo Reparto:
  • Avrai la responsabilità di gestire, motivare e ascoltare il team di Addetti/e vendita e Specialisti/e del tuo reparto, allo scopo di raggiungere gli obiettivi del reparto;
  • Ti coordinerai con il/la Responsabile di Mercato e i/le Capi/e Reparto per raggiungere tutti insieme gli obiettivi aziendali;
  • Ti occuperai degli ordini della merce per il tuo reparto e ne monitorerai i dati e i KPI per una performance sempre migliore (vendite, ricavi, soddisfazione clienti, costo del lavoro, ...);
  • Non mancherà il lavoro operativo, dietro il banco, in ufficio e in magazzino, così potrai contribuire in prima persona al raggiungimento degli obiettivi.
Per saperne di più su questa posizione, clicca qui per vedere la testimonianza di Rosa.
COSA TI POSSIAMO OFFRIRE?
  • Ricevi incentivi economici e buoni spesa in base al raggiungimento degli obiettivi (vendite del reparto, risultati dell'azienda e del punto vendita, reclutamento candidati, ...)
  • Accedi al welfare aziendale con sconti sui servizi e i prodotti delle aziende partner
  • Cresci come professionista verso percorsi di carriera senza limiti
  • Fruisci di programmi formativi di prim'ordine e tagliati sulle tue esigenze sia in ambito tecnico (formazione mestieri) che in ambito manageriale (aula e e-learning)
  • Affidati ad un'azienda solida e strutturata che investe sull'innovazione e il digitale
  • Entra in un ambiente di lavoro accogliente in cui tutti lavorano insieme verso obiettivi comuni
QUALI SONO I PROSSIMI STEP?
Se la tua candidatura risulterà in linea con le caratteristiche descritte sopra, ti contatteremo per un primo colloquio conoscitivo in remoto. A seconda dell'esito di questo primo colloquio, potresti incontrare in presenza il/la Responsabile del Personale della zona di riferimento.
ASPETTIAMO IL TUO CV!
  • ma se questa offerta di lavoro non fa per te, consulta le altre pubblicate sulla pagina Offerte di lavoro :)
Carrefour Italia opera nel settore della grande distribuzione in Italia con una rete multi-formato di oltre 1.200 punti vendita, di cui oltre 900 in franchising, nonché con servizi di spesa online e un approccio omnicanale in continuo sviluppo. Presente in Italia dal 1972, l’azienda è leader del franchising nella GDO, guidata da una piena focalizzazione sul cliente e da una costante propensione all’innovazione. Impegnata per valorizzare il Made in Italy agroalimentare, fa parte di Filiera Italia dal 2021 e nel 2022 ha favorito l’esportazione di prodotti italiani nel mondo per circa 1,1 miliardi di euro. Con l'obiettivo di favorire la transizione alimentare per tutti, porta avanti ogni giorno il programma “Act For Food”, per offrire un'alimentazione di qualità a prezzi accessibili e dal 2023 è diventata Società Benefit. Impiega oltre 10.000 persone nella propria rete di punti vendita diretti. Nel 2024 ha ottenuto per il settimo anno consecutivo il riconoscimento di Top Employer.
In Carrefour valorizziamo le nostre differenze perché sono per noi simbolo di autenticità e ricchezza. Da anni ci adoperiamo per consolidare una cultura aziendale basata sull'inclusione e sull'equità. Promuoviamo la diversità all'interno dei nostri team di lavoro e la parità retributiva tra uomini e donne. I nostri ruoli sono aperti a tutti e il processo di selezione si basa su competenze reali, motivazione, capacità professionali e interpersonali.

Managing Consultant, Advisors – Strategy & Transformation

Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Title And Summary
Managing Consultant, Advisors – Strategy & Transformation
Advisors & Consulting Services
Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors & Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.
The Advisors & Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy & Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Strategy & Transformation consultants lead clients through impactful decision-making as they tackle strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational business challenges. They apply a broad set of problem-solving techniques to improve the client’s overall strategy, performance, and operations.
Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. Please review our consulting specializations to learn more about all opportunities and apply for the position that is best suited to your background and experience: and Responsibilities
Client Impact

  • Lead client engagements across a range of industries and problem statements
  • Develop strategies and programs for large, regional, and global clients by leveraging data and technology solutions to unlock client value
  • Own key relationships with mid-level to senior client stakeholders and independently assess client agenda, internal culture, and change readiness

Team Collaboration & Culture
  • Lead team to creative insights and sound business recommendations, and deliver impactful client presentations while growing team members’ roles and skills
  • Provide analytical and day-to-day project delivery team leadership, and create a collaborative and inclusive environment for all levels
  • Collaborate with internal Mastercard stakeholders including Product and Business Development to scope projects, create relevant solutions for clients, and build the firm's intellectual capital
  • Provide on-the-job training, coaching, and mentorship to junior consultants

Qualifications
Basic qualifications
  • Undergraduate degree with work experience in consulting, corporate strategy, business intelligence, business line management, or product management
  • Experience coaching and managing teams across multiple consulting engagements that involve structured problem solving and stakeholder management
  • Experience managing key client relationships
  • Knowledge of business KPIs, financials, and organizational leadership
  • Ability to identify new business development opportunities, and experience drafting proposals and scoping new opportunities
  • Logical, structured thinking, and affinity for numerical analysis
  • Advanced Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and clients in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English and the local office language (if applicable)
  • Eligibility to work in the country where you are applying, as well as apply for travel visas as required by travel needs

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience generating new knowledge or creating innovative solutions for a firm
  • Relevant industry expertise
  • MBA or master’s degree with relevant specialization (not required)
  • As Mastercard is a global company, we sometimes have team members from outside of the location listed on this posting that are reviewing submitted applications. Please attach a copy of your resume in English to expedite the screening process.

Our Purpose
We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.
Corporate Security Responsibility
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

  • Perfil colaborativo, analítico e com senso de dono.

title: Paid Media Specialist
description:
Join to apply for the Paid Media Specialist role at Darkroom

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Paid Media Specialist role at Darkroom

We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it.
Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. ), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
We are hiring a Paid Media Specialist - a performance-driven marketer with a strong command of paid media strategy, campaign execution, and data analysis. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms.
You’ll report to the Managing Director of Growth and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high-growth U.S. brands. You’ll be responsible for owning campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, brand, and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.
This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end-to-end.
Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Barcelona, Brazil, and Colombia.
 What you'll do:

  • Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies to increase brand visibility and recognition and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.
  • Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.
  • Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.
  • Manage between 5-10 paid media accounts (including but not limited to: Google/YouTube Ads, Pinterest, Facebook/Instagram Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other social platforms like Twitter and TikTok) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $25,000 - $1M.
  • Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, and Google Analytics to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.
  • Understand important KPI and industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.
  • Implement real-time and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platforms.
  • Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.
  • Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.
  • Understand digital marketing best practices and readily contribute to overarching marketing strategies to ensure client success across the board - even if it's paid media adjacent or outside of channel control.
  • Understand full-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new acquisition, list growth, e-commerce, website CRO, retention, and overall client success based on marketing discussions and strategies that work in tandem with paid media and performance efforts.
  • Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy
What you'll need to be successful:
  • 5+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience preferred (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).
  • 5+ years minimum managing paid search and paid social advertising for growth clients, or clients spending $100k+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.
  • Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and creative
  • Experience in keyword targeting and audience optimization across multiple platforms
  • Background in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert
  • Background in data-derived decision-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results
  • Experience using Google Analytics to develop insights and report them to stakeholders
What It's Like To Work At Darkroom
We're building the future of advertising and are looking for the minds to help us do it. We only seek out the best—from our clients to our people. Our team is our most sacred asset, and we offer highly competitive salaries and the following perks:
  • Unlimited Vacation Policy and Holidays: Rebooting is one of the most important parts of growth. At Darkroom, you have access to a flexible vacation policy and 10 holidays throughout the year to keep you recharged and sharp.
  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision benefits, so you can stay as healthy as can be.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Equity incentives, and a profit-sharing opportunity so we can help you save as the company grows.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

  • Atuamos como um só time - promovendo a inclusão, a colaboração e o respeito;
  • Buscamos a excelência - sendo ágeis, inovadores e eficientes;
  • Fazemos o que é certo - agindo de forma segura, ética e sustentável.

Estamos transformando nossa cultura, promovendo a colaboração e o respeito entre todos, de maneira ampla e abrangente.

Em nosso processo de inscrição, todas as candidaturas serão avaliadas ao longo de três meses. Os candidatos com perfil adequado às vagas disponíveis serão contatados para participar do processo seletivo. Ressaltamos que o contato não garante contratação. Independentemente do resultado, todos receberão um retorno sobre sua inscrição. Em caso de negativa, manteremos seu currículo em nosso banco de dados para futuras oportunidades. As etapas já realizadas poderão ser consideradas ou refeitas, dependendo dos requisitos da vaga.

Presente em mais de 40 países, líder mundial em processamento de oleaginosas e uma das maiores produtoras e fornecedoras de óleos, gorduras e proteínas vegetais há mais de dois séculos, a Bunge trabalha com o propósito de conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Há 120 anos no Brasil, contamos com mais de 100 unidades e somos uma das principais empresas de agronegócio e alimentos, líder em originação de grãos e em processamento de soja e trigo. Em todas as nossas cadeias de valor promovemos nossos negócios de maneira sustentável ao mesmo tempo que apoiamos o bem-estar social e econômico das comunidades onde atuamos.

This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities:

Who we are!

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L.L.C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.

In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.

ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision – laying the groundwork for long-term success.

Why Join Us?

As a Senior Digital Construction Coordinator , you'll be responsible for overseeing information management using BIM (Building Information Modeling) across the project, ensuring all stakeholders meet digital deliverables and project requirements. While the role may involve other digital construction methods such as scanning, drones, and robotics, the primary focus is BIM. The coordinator serves as the main point of contact for BIM between the project management team and external stakeholders including the client, consultants, and subcontractors.

Your Role:

  • Manage and interpret client BIM expectations and deliverables.
  • Communicate information requirements internally and externally.
  • Develop and maintain BIM documentation such as the BIM execution plan, exchange information requirements, responsibility matrix, and master information delivery plan.
  • Set up and manage BIM workflows from contract award through project handover.
  • Ensure the electronic document management system supports the common data environment processes.
  • Lead 3D model coordination and issue resolution, including clash detection.
  • Provide training, coaching, and support for BIM processes and related technologies.
  • Estimate resource requirements for direct and subcontracted works.
  • Implement quality assurance and control for models and BIM processes.
  • Represent BIM and digital construction at project meetings.
  • Report on BIM progress and compliance at the project level.
  • Support tender submissions and contribute to departmental process development.

What We're looking For

  • Strong understanding of ISO 19650 and familiarity with the 1192 standards.
  • Proficiency in BIM authoring software such as Revit, Tekla, or Archicad.
  • Experience with BIM coordination tools such as Navisworks or Revizto.
  • Knowledge of openBIM standards including IFC and COBie.
  • Ability to use tools for automated model checking and data validation such as Solibri.
  • Experience with cloud-based collaboration platforms used in CDE workflows such as Aconex or BIM 360.
  • Familiarity with scheduling tools such as MS Project or Primavera P6.
  • Experience in programming or visual programming (Dynamo preferred).
  • Understanding of 4D and 5D processes and their implementation.
  • Ability to use data reporting tools such as MS Power BI.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborative and adaptable with a proactive mindset.
  • Confident, assertive, and resilient under pressure.
  • Analytical with a keen eye for detail and accuracy.
  • Highly organized with excellent time management.
  • Passionate about BIM and digital transformation in construction.

What We Offer

  • The chance to contribute to some of the UAE’s most iconic developments
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture focused on innovation and operational excellence
  • Long-term career development in a well-established, growing organization

Responsibilities
About the Team:
Our E-commerce's Governance and Experience is a global team responsible for ensuring our marketplace is safe and trustworthy for not only users but also sellers and creators. We value user experience and work on policies, rules, products, and systems to ensure quality. We are looking for passionate talents to join us, thus together we can build a e-commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure, and intuitive for our users.
As a Quality Assurance Program Manager, you will lead efforts to drive continuous improvement across our users, partners and creators. Your focus will be on resolving DSAT (Dissatisfaction) issues, improving 24-hour resolution rates, and enhancing RSAT (Resolution Satisfaction). You will ensure quality frameworks are in place, scalable processes are implemented, and operational excellence is achieved through collaboration with cross-regional stakeholders. This role requires a proactive approach to problem-solving, process optimization, and stakeholder engagement.
Responsibilities:
- Ensure that the quality framework is in place based on the business types/facts by coordinating across regions and stakeholders, producing statistical reports and insights on quality performance.
- Implement a clear overall quality strategy with scalable processes, tools, and systems that allow efficient performance monitoring versus target.
- Access quality issues, conduct root cause analysis, recommend insights, develop improvement plans, and collaborate with operations teams to improve quality performance.
- Research and understand customer expectations and needs to drive their satisfaction.
- Attends periodic calibration sessions with QA and Operations to ensure calibration on program-related issues.
- Work with BPO suppliers to ensure a high performing tier 1 team to provide world-class services to customers, sellers and creators.
- Be responsible for the overall coordination and execution of the BPO suppliers' operational performance, push service quality and cost efficiency to a healthy trend.
- Coordinate and execute complex customer/seller/creator services related projects in BPO sites.
- Identify, develop, and drive plans to ensure BPO is meeting all performance-related metrics (e.g. – customer satisfaction, service level, handle time).
- Maintain a scorecard by BPO supplier, can prove the BPO success with solid data analysis.
- Own vendor cost per contact trending well. Manage cost related metrics like AHT, repeated contacts, and etc. Audit monthly billing invoices prior to submission for accuracy.
- Own all operational escalations from vendor sites and ensure complete root cause deep dive analysis is completed each time to understand and drive improvements throughout the organization.
- A high volume of travel is required to the local BPO site.
- Ability to attend some night-time meetings including occasional weekend coverage for high level escalations as needed.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience required.
- 5+ years in managing global contact center business, BPO management experience is preferred.
- Fluency in English and Portuguese is required for the role.
- Experience working with and managing outsourced vendors.
- Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience in e-commerce or marketplace platforms is a plus.

At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
Project & Program Manager II, Performance Team
Pinterest is looking for a Program Manager. This role is responsible for enabling advertisers and sellers to drive success on the Pinterest platform, for supporting cross-functional teams' operations and adapting new solutions through scalable programs at Pinterest. The Program Manager will closely partner with cross-functional leads in sales, measurement, brand solutions, product and engineering, among others, and will be responsible for ideating and managing end-to-end global programs that may involve foundation enhancements, advertiser and campaign activation, performance, data analysis, reporting and XFN scaled solutions. This is a multi-faceted, fast-paced job in a start-up environment so flexibility, a data-driven mindset, a strong work ethic, and a good sense of humor are a must. The right candidate will be a strategic thought leader who is driven by learning and solving ambiguous problems.
Performance Solutions delivers through strategic guidance, operational excellence and technical expertise to improve the effectiveness of advertising campaigns resulting in increased client ROI. We work to understand, innovate, and scale cross-functional workflows. We are responsible for measuring process impact, making our business more efficient with consistent execution while embarking on building the next generation of data-driven best practices.
What You’ll Do

  • Coordinate and oversee multiple programs, defining their strategy and managing these programs end-to-end.
  • Drive and scale execution on multiple program and project deliverables, collaborating across cross-functional teams, managing vendors, budgets and timelines for effective delivery.
  • Develop solutions and frameworks to enhance program efficiency based on identified problems or organizational needs.
  • Identify key challenges faced by sales teams, advertisers, and cross-functional partners, proposing effective solutions aligned with program objectives.
  • Ideate and manage new pilots and programs based on strategic business needs.
  • Define success metrics and track the evolution, adoption, and impact of the program, implementing improvements as needed.
  • Provide regular reports on desired metrics and SLAs to cross-functional partners and leadership.

What We’re Looking For
  • 3+ years of expertise in Program Management and operations or relevant experience.
  • Proactively respond to ambiguous problems and lead efforts towards effective solutions.
  • Ability to clearly and consistently work side-by-side across functions and departments synthesizing multiple points of view into a coherent action plan.
  • Inspire and influence cross-functional teams to achieve program goals.
  • Demonstrate a curious and independent learning mindset.
  • Analytical and process-oriented, comfortable working with large data sets and making data-driven decisions.
  • Advanced Excel modeling required, building business cases and narratives via PowerPoint and verbally.
  • SQL knowledge is required.
  • Experience with online advertising is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as project management, or equivalent experience.

If you are a self-motivated Program Manager with a passion for driving results and solving complex challenges, we invite you to join our dynamic team and contribute to the success of our programs.
Relocation Statement:
  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement
  • We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times per every 6 months.

Our Commitment To Inclusion
Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. About Us:
At ID Logistics we are dedicated to fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment where every team member is welcomed and valued. As a leading global 3PL (3rd party logistics) transportation organization with over 35,000 employees in over 400 sites across 18 countries, we pride ourselves on our customer first approach and commitment to operational excellence.
Position Overview:
The Maintenance Supervisor oversees all equipment within the contract packaging operation. Responsibilities include overseeing equipment preventative maintenance, unplanned repairs, lock out tag out, OSHA requirements, operator training, and vendor management. The Maintenance Supervisor will lead the maintenance team to support business operations in a contract packaging operation. This qualified individual will be responsible for maintaining existing preventive maintenance programs, SOP’s and procedures as well as developing new programs and procedures where appropriate. The Maintenance Supervisor will work to provide support to the Distribution Operations Leadership team to ensure productivity. The Maintenance Supervisor will build and strengthen relationships with vendors, track and analyze data, and manage administration related to projects. Will follow corporate and site-specific Good Manufacturing Practices and report noncompliance when observed. In addition, the candidate will observe all company safety rules and assist in enforcement as appropriate.
Work Location: This is an on-site role at our Bethlehem, PA Distribution Center
Work Schedule: First Shift: Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm
Work Travel: Less than 5% domestic travel required
Competitive Total Rewards Package: Attractive annual salary of $80,000 - $85,000 plus a performance-based bonus, with benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) matching, and more.
Responsibilities:

  • Implement all maintenance activities at the site, ensuring repairs and changes are performed timely and flawlessly.
  • Responsible for planning and supervising all hourly maintenance associates
  • Determine day to day priority scheduling and follow up of all maintenance activities and associates performing such work
  • Ensure all necessary facilities systems are kept in reliable working condition and that they meet any required customer / regulatory specifications
  • Develop and implement a maintenance associate development plan to ensure training and development of all associates supervised
  • Coordinate all planned projects and outages with affected parties.
  • Regular inspection of all electrical and power units of a facility
  • Detecting malfunctions and defects in electrical systems and vehicle engines and repairing the same
  • Ensuring the compliance of all corporate policies and the Occupational Safety and health administration rules (OSHA) while conducting work functions
  • Maintaining a record of service cycles and other maintenance activities conducted
  • Efficiently managing time and completing all tasks assigned by the supervisory authority
  • Reporting damages, defects and other issues pertaining to electrical units to the supervising manager
  • Placing orders for spare and replacement parts and completing all necessary documentation for the same
  • Appropriately using and handling all electrical repair and testing tools and equipment
  • Light building maintenance repairs. Changing bulbs, painting, caulking, etc
  • Daily parts and tools inventory counts
  • Moving equipment or installing new equipment
  • Follow corporate and site-specific Good Manufacturing Practices and report noncompliance when observed.
  • Observe all company safety rules and assist in enforcement as appropriate.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Be part of a forward-thinking company that values creativity and continuous improvement. We offer opportunities for professional development and career advancement within a growing organization. Join a diverse, collaborative team that emphasizes respect and inclusivity.

Minimum Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in the field of Information Technology or Logistics desired, or equivalent experience
  • Working knowledge of the Microsoft Windows 10 and Microsoft server product line, Microsoft Office suite, TCP/IP, VPN technologies, data backup, virus protection, and network system monitoring
  • Analytical thinker comfortable with managing technical operations
  • Excellent diagnostic and problem-solving skills
  • Outstanding organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent communication skills (verbal, written, and presentation)
  • In depth understanding of diverse computer systems and networks
  • Good knowledge of internet security and data privacy principles
  • 3+ years end user support experience
  • 3+ years WMS experience desired
  • RF technology experience
  • Flexibility to share on call support within 24/7 operation.

In this role, you’ll be the go-to IT expert for regional support across our Louisiana, Florida, and Georgia locations. You’ll work directly with our field service teams and local office staff to deliver high-quality technical support and ensure the smooth operation of our systems, infrastructure, and cloud services.
You’ll support an industrial services company that operates 24/7, meaning some off-hours or weekend support may be needed. You will participate in an on-call rotation schedule for off hours and weekends.

️ Cloud Services & Systems Support
  • Support Azure Universal Print configuration and troubleshooting

Collaboration & Travel

  • Familiarity with Conditional Access policies in Azure AD

  • Able to work independently and manage tasks across multiple locations

About The Team
Process & Tooling Productivity Product Manager | SAP Application Foundation
The Application Foundation Team owns the mission of improving efficiency across SAP and enabling the Application and Service Teams to deliver value to customers at low cost.
The Application Foundation Productivity team’s mission is to drive measurable improvements in engineering productivity through the harmonization of internal platforms and streamlined processes. This team is focused on enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of internal development teams by improving tools and processes, while adhering to all product standards.
This cross-functional team works across a wide range of domains, including—but not limited to—product standards, security, compliance, cost optimization, and reporting. We manage both internally developed tools and externally adopted platforms, ensuring they are aligned with engineering needs and business goals. Our work spans internal enablement and external product management, supporting the full lifecycle of tools used by engineering teams.
You will join a group responsible for defining, implementing and improving internal KPIs, establishing tooling and rolling out scalable, standardized processes across all of Application Foundation. The team leads initiatives to improve productivity through AI-driven solutions, streamlined execution tracking, and consistent adoption of tools and practices.
What You'll Do

  • Ability to evaluate, standardize, and support the rollout of internal and third-party tools that enhance developer productivity, ensuring alignment with engineering needs and business goals.

  • Lead the exploration and integration of Agentic AI and automation technologies to reduce manual effort, improve execution tracking, and enhance decision-making across engineering teams.

  • Strong stakeholder management and effective communication skills including the ability to share and communicate ideas at various levels of the organization including executive staff, business sponsors and other key constituents in clear
  • Strong people skills, driving, understanding and leading people to successful outcomes
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering both internal and external-facing features and projects, resulting in measurable outcomes such as increased NPS, user engagement, and business growth.
  • Excellent English language skills, both oral and written
What We Expect From You
  • Understanding of Agentic AI systems and their application in engineering workflows
  • Ability to identify high-leverage AI use cases to augment/streamline internal repetitive tasks

Estamos empenhados em criar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde talento pode encontrar espaço para prosperar e se desenvolver. Prezamos por um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, plural e que valoriza o respeito, a ética e a igualdade de oportunidades para todos!

Job Description

  • We're looking for: A motivated self-starter who can handle a high-velocity sales approach while providing an excellent customer experience! Our Digital Inside Sales Specialists are at the forefront of our customer experience for both new and existing customers of Zendesk. In the role, you will become a product expert and articulate the value of Zendesk to an informed buyer. You will do this by providing several touch points across the customer journey to help them have an informed buying decision. This is a new team at Zendesk, so you will be one of the founding members in what will be a fast-growing area for our business.

  • Ideal candidates joining our team will bring a consistent track record in achieving targets; Software/SaaS experience is a plus. Travel to a Zendesk office is required throughout training and then will move to a hybrid schedule.

  • Responsibilities

    • Respond to a large number of inbound leads and existing customers through various channels, primarily through chat and email.

    • Actively resolve prospect and customer inquiries to drive online business conversion rates

    • Become an expert on Zendesk products

    • Be the voice of our customers; understand their needs and make them champions

    • Meet or exceed SLAs and KPIs established for the role, including but not limited to: ticket volumes, response and resolution times, and productivity. You will also have a shared revenue target to contribute to.

    • Exceed activity, pipeline, and revenue goals on a weekly basis

  • Required

    • Excellent communication skills in English

    • Will require working with clients/prospects across Zendesk’s global market

    • 1+ years of sales experience; software/SaaS experience preferred

    • Real passion for Zendesk technology and quick ability to learn tools and processes

    • Outstanding organizational skills, with the ability to multitask a high volume of opportunities at all times

    • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, think strategically and excel at tactical execution against a task

Where We Work

Zendesk is not your average tech company. We have all the stuff you’d expect - competitive pay, benefits, appealing offices, snacks, and more. We also have a culture deeply dedicated to enabling conversations and providing appreciative support. We help our staff keep work-life balance, from flexible hours to remote work, to the most dynamic parental leave plans on the market. Our Social Impact team is actively engaged in our community and enables us to invest thousands of hours with local community groups each year. We invest in diversity and inclusion so that our team reflects the diversity of the world around us. We have a whole crew dedicated to ensuring our workplace experience is top notch and welcoming for all.

Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

The intelligent heart of customer experience

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.

Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.

Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here .

Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to with your specific accommodation request.

About Us

Zendesk is on a mission to simplify the complexity of business and make it easy for companies and customers to create connections.

Our customer experience software unlocks the power of billions of interactions, enabling businesses to build rich, meaningful relationships with their customers.

More meaningful moments. Fewer Zoom calls.

What’s it like to work here? Our offices reflect the global cities we call home, and have spaces for collaboration, quiet, and events.

With our hybrid approach, you’ll experience flexibility and connection, collaboration, and learning with your team.

Recruitment Scam Alerts

We’re aware of an increase in recruitment scams where individuals falsely claim to represent Zendesk. These scammers may ask for money or personal information by offering fake job opportunities through e-mail, text message or social media. Please verify the source of any job-related communications carefully. All official Zendesk communications are conducted through "@ zendesk.com " email addresses. Transforme o futuro com a Minsait

Transforme o futuro com a Minsait
Na Minsait , acreditamos na tecnologia como força para transformar realidades e gerar impacto positivo. Desenvolvemos soluções que conectam inovação, eficiência e progresso em setores essenciais como administração pública, telecomunicações & mídia, energia & utilities, indústria & consumo, saúde e finanças .

Valores

Se você busca desafios com significado, a Minsait é o seu lugar.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Solução experiente e apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar nossa equipe.
Você será responsável por projetar e implementar soluções escaláveis e resilientes
atuando como um elo fundamental entre as necessidades de negócio e as capacidades técnicas.
Se você possui um histórico comprovado em arquitetura de soluções complexas, domina plataformas de nuvem como GCP e Oracle Cloud
tem experiência com microserviços e ambientes multi-cloud, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade.
Responsabilidades:
  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar arquiteturas de software robustas e escaláveis, com foco em soluções baseadas em Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).
  • Liderar a definição de padrões e melhores práticas de arquitetura para microserviços, garantindo a qualidade e a performance das soluções. Avaliar e propor soluções em ambientes multi-cloud, garantindo a interoperabilidade e a otimização de recursos entre diferentes provedores. Colaborar de perto com equipes de desenvolvimento, produto e operações para traduzir requisitos de negócio em especificações técnicas detalhadas.
  • Fornecer orientação técnica e mentoria para as equipes de desenvolvimento, promovendo a adoção de tecnologias e metodologias inovadoras. Participar ativamente na análise de riscos técnicos e na mitigação de problemas potenciais.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as últimas tendências e tecnologias do mercado, especialmente em nuvem, microserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas.

Requisitos e qualificações
Pré-requisitos:
  • Experiência comprovada de mais de 5 anos em Google Cloud Platform (GCP), com profundo conhecimento em serviços como Compute Engine, Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Cloud Functions, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, entre outros.
  • Experiência em Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), incluindo serviços de computação, rede, banco de dados e armazenamento.
  • Experiência sólida em arquitetura e desenvolvimento de microserviços, incluindo padrões de comunicação, resiliência e observabilidade.
  • Experiência prática com ambientes Multi-Cloud, compreendendo os desafios e as estratégias para integrar e gerenciar soluções em diferentes provedores de nuvem.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com .NET 8
  • Experiência com angular para o desenvolvimento de aplicações front-end.
  • Inglês Intermediário (capacidade de ler documentação técnica e participar de reuniões).
  • Espanhol Avançado/Fluente (comunicação eficaz com equipes e stakeholders).
  • Observabilidade: Zabbix e Dynatrace

Diferenciais:
  • Certificações GCP (Ex: Professional Cloud Architect) ou OCI (Ex: OCI Architect Associate/Professional).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em DevOps e CI/CD.

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Job Summary:

As a Junior CMMS Engineer, you will play a critical role in ensuring optimal maintenance and inventory processes within our Offshore Production business unit.

This position requires not only strong analytical and communication skills but also a hands-on approach to supporting end users and maintaining system data integrity.

You will be a key contributor to our continuous improvement initiatives, working collaboratively with various teams to enhance our operations

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide ongoing support for Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) activities across all operating assets in Brazil, fostering a seamless operational environment.
  • Deliver hands-on training to end-users on IFS CMMS and related maintenance and inventory processes, ensuring their competence and confidence in utilising the system.
  • Monitor CMMS system usage, advocate best practices, and implement efficiencies to protect the integrity and functionality of the system.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and enhancement of Maintenance & Inventory KPIs across Brazil’s operational units, providing insight that drives performance.
  • Support the Functional Manager and Operational Managers in analysing maintenance and inventory performance, facilitating informed decision-making.
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency within the CMMS, collaborating effectively with team members to uphold high standards.
  • Actively participate as a member of the Support Issue team, executing tasks and responsibilities related to maintenance and inventory support.
  • Advocate for the use of CMMS, underscoring the importance of defined processes, tools, and standards within the team and broader organisation.

Duties:

  • Participate actively in meetings as required, engaging with the ALM Maintenance and Inventory team to foster collaboration and communication.
  • Conduct regular reviews and analyses of maintenance-related KPIs for Brazilian units, identifying areas for improvement and driving operational excellence.
  • Perform both offshore and onshore site visits as necessary to aid in system usage and facilitate training opportunities.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support integrated processes that encompass maintenance and inventory management.
  • Provide necessary budget input to asset Operation Managers as required, ensuring financial prudence within the Brazil units.
  • Carry out additional tasks and responsibilities as required, contributing to the broader goals of the department.

Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in Structural, Mechanical, Marine, or Offshore Engineering, or equivalent education and relevant industry experience.
  • Experience in the offshore maintenance industry, specifically with comparable ERP systems, with preference given to those who have worked with IFS.
  • Experience in strategy optimisation is advantageous, enabling you to influence process improvements effectively.
  • Proven experience in working in a global environment, collaborating successfully with diverse teams.

Skills:

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, capable of addressing complex challenges effectively.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills that foster collaboration and respect across teams.
  • Exceptional organisational and administrative skills, with a keen attention to quality, detail, and the ability to prioritise effectively.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of industry standards and regulations, ensuring compliance at every level of operation.

We are committed to creating an inclusive work environment where diverse perspectives are valued and innovation is encouraged. We look forward to seeing how your unique skills and experiences can enhance our operations.

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

title: Product Designer Sênior
description:
Como Product Designer Sênior, você será responsável pela evolução da Brandpage do Reclame AQUI, o principal ponto de contato entre as empresas e milhões de consumidores. Sua missão é ir além da execução técnica, liderando iniciativas de design de ponta a ponta que resolvem problemas complexos e geram impacto direto nos resultados de negócio das marcas que confiam em nossa plataforma.

Atuando na tribo de Empresas, você terá autonomia e responsabilidade de aprofundar o entendimento sobre as dores e necessidades das marcas, traduzindo insights de dados e pesquisas em soluções de experiência e interface intuitivas e eficazes, ajudando as empresas a construir e gerenciar sua reputação de forma estratégica.

Esperamos que você atue com alto grau de ownership, influenciando a visão do produto, colaborando com Produto e Tecnologia, e elevando a qualidade do design no produto e no Reclame AQUI.

Responsabilidades:

  1. Análise de Dados: Familiaridade com análise de indicadores de produto e negócio para identificar problemas e oportunidades.
  2. Pensamento Sistêmico: Desejo de desenvolver sua capacidade de pensar de forma sistêmica, entendendo como as ferramentas de design impactam e interagem em um ecossistema maior.
  3. Mapeamento de Jornadas e Processos: Conhecimento em mapeamento de jornadas de produto e serviço, identificando dores e necessidades que, ao serem resolvidas, melhoram processos de trabalho.
  4. Storytelling: Comunicação e apresentação do trabalho de forma organizada, estruturada e objetiva, engajando partes interessadas e transmitindo o valor do design.
  5. Visual Design: Experiência na concepção, criação e prototipação de interfaces para diferentes plataformas.
  6. UX Design: Aplicação de princípios de design centrado no usuário, incluindo pesquisa, criação de personas, mapeamento de jornada do usuário e cenários de uso.
  7. Content Design: Habilidade na escrita de textos claros e concisos, alinhados à estratégia de experiência da solução.
  8. UX Research: Capacidade de conduzir pesquisas quantitativas, qualitativas e testes de usabilidade para explorar, validar e iterar soluções de design.
  9. Ferramentas: Domínio de ferramentas como Figma, Miro, Useberry, VWO, Jira e similares.
  10. Empatia e Adaptabilidade: Forte capacidade de entender e antecipar necessidades de clientes e colegas, adaptando-se a mudanças.
  11. Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades para articular ideias complexas para stakeholders de todos os níveis.
  12. Pensamento Crítico: Facilidade para analisar problemas complexos e trabalhar proativamente em soluções.
  13. Atenção a Detalhes: Compromisso com a qualidade das entregas.
  14. Proatividade e Colaboração: Vontade de buscar melhorias, colaborar e promover uma cultura positiva de design.

Requisitos:

  1. Proficiência em Análise de Dados: Capacidade de analisar métricas de produto e indicadores de negócio, identificando problemas, validando hipóteses e medindo impacto.
  2. Pensamento Sistêmico: Capacidade de pensar de forma sistêmica, entendendo a conexão das soluções da Brand Page com o ecossistema maior de produtos.
  3. Storytelling e Articulação: Excelência na comunicação e apresentação de trabalho, defendendo decisões de design e influenciando stakeholders.
  4. Visual Design: Experiência avançada em planejamento, concepção e prototipação de interfaces para plataformas web, com atenção a detalhes e princípios de UI.
  5. UX Design: Domínio na aplicação de princípios de design centrado no usuário, liderando criação de jornadas, personas e arquitetura da informação.
  6. UX Research: Experiência na condução de pesquisas completas, desde planejamento até análise de resultados.
  7. Content Design: Habilidade na criação de textos claros, concisos e alinhados à voz da marca.
  8. Ferramentas: Domínio de Figma, Useberry, Maze, Jira, Miro, além de curiosidade por novas ferramentas.
  9. Habilidades comportamentais: Empatia, visão de negócio, comunicação, influência, pensamento crítico, autonomia, ownership, colaboração e liderança pelo exemplo.

title: Implementation Project Manager
description:
We're quickly growing and super excited for you to join us!

About Topsort

Today, Topsort has 5 major hubs worldwide, and employees in 13+ countries, including Menlo Park, Boston, Santiago Chile, Sao Paulo Brazil, Barcelona Spain, and Sydney Australia. We are a truly global company that was born in the pandemic and has experienced rapid growth since our founding in 2021, driven by a genius product, a customer-first mentality, and a talented team. We serve customers in retail, marketplaces, and delivery apps across 40+ countries and are approaching the industry’s #1 position.

Do you enjoy a fast-paced environment? Do you like seeing your work create real-time impact and being part of a rocket ship from the very beginning? Let’s innovate together—making ads clean and cool again with AI and modern technology.

What it’s like to work at Topsort

Our team values straightforward communication, embracing feedback, and fostering a collaborative environment. We operate like a sports team focused on winning, with internal collaboration and external competitiveness. We prioritize open work, mutual support, and a sense of urgency, avoiding endless meetings—if it can be done today, we do it today.

What is this role like?

We’re seeking a highly skilled Project Manager with strong product instincts and deep technical expertise. You will lead complex initiatives end-to-end, working closely with engineering and business teams to translate technical possibilities into real product value. You’ll thrive in a fast-paced environment and help shape our platform’s future.

  • Manage customer onboarding to ensure successful outcomes, driving growth and retention.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to train customers on using Topsort’s platform and features effectively.
  • Set KPIs and success metrics, ensuring full ROI for clients.
  • Ensure smooth transition to the Customer Success team by documenting client stakeholder roles.
  • Improve onboarding processes and training materials to enhance the experience.
  • Coordinate with client agencies and third parties to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Work with the development team to ensure custom development meets client expectations and standards.
  • Own the project, taking responsibility for successful implementation while working with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate user training and workshops to empower clients effectively.

What (we think) you need to be successful

We’re open to candidates who may not check all boxes but can demonstrate exceptional skills and potential.

  • Minimum of 3 years experience in SaaS project management and client onboarding.
  • PM qualifications such as Agile, PMP.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, in English.
  • Proven success in delivering projects efficiently and on time.
  • Understanding of Webhooks and APIs.
  • Experience with AI-driven product recommendation tools and algorithms is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CRM, ERP, or Marketing Automation platforms.

What We Value

We seek professionals who embody these qualities:

  • Attention to detail: Dive deep to uncover root causes and optimal solutions.
  • Team first: Prioritize collective results over personal recognition.
  • Comfort with ambiguity: Tackle open-ended problems and turn chaos into structured innovation.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to learn, mentor, lead, and follow as needed.
  • Urgency: Act with a sense of urgency while building scalable, repeatable processes.
  • Curiosity: Quickly learn and apply new concepts effectively.

If you think you’re a good fit, we’d love to hear from you!
